wire.voice.spoken.approval_needed.note: {title} is the name of the tool that is asking, for example bash; keep it exactly as given. It is followed by the tool's own approval summary, so end with a full stop. English-only addition with English fallback until independently translated and audited.

wire.voice.spoken.code_omitted.role: Spoken aloud by the desktop voice mode (synthesised by TTS, never shown as text); a short stand-in for skipped code
wire.voice.spoken.code_omitted.note: Said in place of a whole block of code that is skipped, in the middle of a reply. Keep it short; a pair of parentheses around it is optional. English-only addition with English fallback until independently translated and audited.

wire.voice.spoken.link.role: Spoken aloud by the desktop voice mode (synthesised by TTS, never shown as text); a one-word stand-in for a web address
wire.voice.spoken.link.note: Said in place of a web address, in the middle of a sentence. One short word for "link". English-only addition with English fallback until independently translated and audited.
